results.title: A WebSocket prompt carries its reference separately from literal prompt_ref data
A later WebSocket prompt accepts its own reply after a stale replay and a reply without a reference
A malformed reply retains its reference and successful dispatch consumes it before the next prompt
A routed reply consumes its reference even when the input pattern rejects its value; Abort recovers

execution_note: Public anonymous sessions; ordinary actor-owned work; no ownership-lifecycle release gate on live services; N7 case starts paced at least five seconds apart; unmodified assertions/timeouts (core5s/query8s)
